2608.06171.title: Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents
2608.06171.paper_summary: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large but is inflated by run-to-run noise: rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes 12-14% of outcomes, so a second run of a mode already in hand gains about as much as adding a new one. What survives is a cost bound: sending only the tasks no mode solves to the cheapest mode cuts cost by 9.5-30.6% in 8 of 8 cells at unchanged success. We then test five routing policies (picking the mode, deciding when to spend on the strong mode, a zero-cost rule read off the task text, a confidence cascade, and pooled cost tiers), and none robustly beats simply fixing one well-chosen mode; the one exception is a fragile result in our sparsest cell. The central obstruction is that routing supervision is produced at the agent's success rate: the weaker the agent, the fewer labels a router gets, exactly where routing would be most valuable. This limit belongs to today's agents rather than to routing itself. Label supply and routing opportunity rise together (correlation 0.95 across cells), so a stronger agent can overturn the result, and we report the rerun noise bands and the full measurement protocol.
2608.06171.paper_summary_zh: 網路代理透過文本、像素或兩者來觀察瀏覽器，且這種選擇通常在所有任務中是一成不變的。我們在 VisualWebArena 和 WebArena 上測量了六種觀察模式，涵蓋八種網站模型組合（單元），並詢問每個任務的選擇會帶來什麼。這些模式是互補的：每種模式解決了其他模式無法解決的任務，它們在結構上以不同的方式失敗，而最佳選擇在任務集之間會有所反轉。顯而易見的獎勵是一個為每個任務選擇獲勝模式的神諭，看似龐大，但由於運行之間的噪音而被膨脹：在相同任務上重新運行相同模式會改變 12-14% 的結果，因此已經掌握的模式的第二次運行所獲得的收益大約與添加一個新模式相當。剩下的只有一個成本界限：將只有沒有模式解決的任務發送到最便宜的模式，可以在成功率不變的情況下將成本降低 9.5-30.6%，在 8 個單元中均如此。我們接著測試了五種路由策略（選擇模式、決定何時在強模式上花費、從任務文本中讀取的零成本規則、信心級聯和聚合成本層級），結果沒有一種能穩健地超越簡單地固定一個精心選擇的模式；唯一的例外是在我們最稀疏的單元中出現的脆弱結果。主要障礙是路由監督是根據代理的成功率產生的：代理越弱，路由器獲得的標籤就越少，恰恰是在路由最有價值的地方。這一限制屬於當今的代理，而不是路由本身。標籤供應和路由機會是一起上升的（在各單元之間的相關性為 0.95），因此更強的代理可以顛覆結果，我們報告了重新運行的噪音帶和完整的測量協議。
